summary: Tax treatment for broken period interest on government securities; SLR compliance by banks; securities as stock-in-trade under banking business; deduction eligibility post-repeal of IT Act Sections 18-21; distinguishing Vijaya Bank precedent; netting of broken period interest against interest recovered; correctness of CIT's interference under Section 263; affirming Bombay HC's American Express/Citi Bank approach.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment set aside; restoration of Tribunal's order permitting broken period interest deduction.
